children: New York Times Kyiv bureau chief Andrew Kramer told Bloomberg This Weekend that Russia and Ukraine are increasingly targeting each other’s economies as the war shifts toward attacks on energy, transportation and export infrastructure.
Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Kramer said Ukraine is using its expanding drone arsenal to target Russia’s oil industry and its ability to finance a prolonged war.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Russia, Ukraine Expand Economic Targets as War Shifts
